# Keating Builders

> Keating Builders is a full-service construction company in Berkshire County, Massachusetts, building new homes and delivering kitchen, bathroom, whole-home renovation and addition projects.

## Services

- New home construction
- Whole-home renovations
- Kitchen renovations
- Bathroom remodels
- Home additions

## Service Area

Berkshire County, Western Massachusetts.

## Contact

- Phone: (413) 555-0100
- Email: info@keatingbuilders.com
- Estimates: https://keatingbuilders.com/contact.html

## About

A local, licensed and insured Massachusetts builder that works directly with each client from the first call to the final walkthrough.
